uncertain.item: Italian army and Luftwaffe/RAF/Armée de l'Air
uncertain.note: Not modelled; Italy appears only as an event and a nation record.
S09 summary says 14 May, S06 says 15 May; scenario uses 15 May.
Qualitative only (S15); probabilities and temperatures are game-scale.

Extra GER initialControl polygons (Luxembourg, the Ardennes up to the Meuse bend, and the Maastricht-Hannut approach) and Luxembourg City owned by GER on 12 May are APPROXIMATE: S06 sources the 10 May occupation of Luxembourg and S08/Sedan article the 12 May advance through southern Belgium, but not the exact line. Added so the German spearheads do not start inside enemy-owned cells and cut off from supply.

Only the existence of a Paris military command (S18) and the reconstituted 10th Army HQ (S17) are sourced. The Paris garrison strength is game-scale; no Somme/Aisne/Paris divisions could be identified from retrievable sources, so none are modelled. French reserve divisions (S04) are placed behind the Maginot Line, not in the Paris region.

Luftwaffe (S19) is a low-confidence forum aggregation; aircraft counts are sums of listed Stab/Gruppe strengths. French groupes use escadrilles x 11 (fighters, S22) or x 10 (bombers, game-scale). RAF squadrons use 16 aircraft each (game-scale; S21 gives no strengths). Airfield coordinates +/-0.15 deg. OMITTED: KG 51 and KG 55 (bases outside the map), Lysander squadrons, reconnaissance and army-co-operation groups (no unit type), French GIABSE bomber groups and ZOAA groups (committed later / in formation), UK-based Fighter Command squadrons (no sourced 10 May 1940 mapping found), Italian air force, Dutch and Belgian air forces. StG 2/StG 77 corps assignment conflicts between sources (VIII. vs IV. Fliegerkorps; VIII. used).
